message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **federal Canadian holidays that create “long weekends”** in 2023.  
(If a holiday falls on a weekend, the *observed* day is usually the following Monday, which also creates a long weekend.)

| # | Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend? | Notes |
|---|---------|-------------|-------------|---------------|-------|
| 1 | New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sunday | **No** | Observed Mon 2 – not a long weekend. |
| 2 | Family Day (BC, AB, SK, NB) | Feb 20 | Monday | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Mon‑Wed). |
| 3 | Good Friday | Apr 7 | Friday | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sun). |
| 4 | Victoria Day | May 22 | Monday | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Mon‑Wed). |
| 5 | Canada Day | Jul 1 | Saturday | **Yes** | Observed Mon 3 – creates a 3‑day weekend (Mon‑Wed). |
| 6 | Labour Day | Sep 4 | Monday | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Mon‑Wed). |
| 7 | Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Monday | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Mon‑Wed). |
| 8 | Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Monday | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Mon‑Wed). |
| 9 | Christmas | Dec 25 | Monday | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Mon‑Wed). |
|10 | Boxing Day | Dec 26 | Tuesday | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Mon‑Wed). |

### Quick Summary

| Long‑Weekend Holiday | Dates (2023) |
|----------------------|--------------|
| Family Day | Feb 20 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 |
| Victoria Day | May 22 |
| Canada Day (observed) | Jul 3 |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 |
| Christmas | Dec 25 |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 |

> **Tip for App Integration**  
> Store the holiday dates in a simple JSON array or database table.  
> Example JSON snippet:
> ```json
> [
>   {"name":"Family Day","date":"2023-02-20"},
>   {"name":"Good Friday","date":"2023-04-07"},
>   {"name":"Victoria Day","date":"2023-05-22"},
>   {"name":"Canada Day","date":"2023-07-03"},
>   {"name":"Labour Day","date":"2023-09-04"},
>   {"name":"Thanksgiving","date":"2023-10-09"},
>   {"name":"Remembrance Day","date":"2023-11-11"},
>   {"name":"Christmas","date":"2023-12-25"},
>   {"name":"Boxing Day","date":"2023-12-26"}
> ]
> ```

### Sources

- [Government of Canada – Federal Holidays](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/benefits/publicpensions.html)  
- [Canada Day – Official Observance Dates](https://www.canada.ca/en/department-finance/news/2023/01/canada-day-2023.html)

Feel free to copy the table or JSON into your holiday‑planning app. If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.), let me know and I can add those too!
